title: Ctrl Z public API
description:
The public API of Ctrl Z: the operations an API token may call.

Make a token in Preferences, API. A token is `read` or `write` for good, may be limited to some addresses, and lives 365 days. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer ctz_...`. A `read` token cannot call an operation that changes anything. A request that carries a session cookie as well is refused, and so is a token on an operation that is not in this document.

Errors are `Error` bodies. A token that is not live is `401 token_invalid`; `403 token_read_only`, `403 token_ip_not_allowed`, `403 token_not_allowed` and `403 account_suspended` say why a live one was refused; `429 rate_limited` carries `Retry-After`.

DocumentUpload.name: DocumentUpload
DocumentUpload.description: The file as base64, at most 4 MiB before encoding. The handler checks it, so every problem is explained.

fields.name: code
fields.description: A stable machine-readable code. The message is localised by the client.

LockPasswords.name: LockPasswords
LockPasswords.description: The lock password of every locked profile the change takes away from an identity (spec 3.3). At most 8.

ProfileDocument.name: ProfileDocument
ProfileDocument.description:
Profile document, version 1 (spec 6.1). The content of a profile and nothing of its identity. A location is
named by its key, a folder by a `ref` local to the document. The type of a profile (spec 5) is such a document
without `name`.

RulesDocument.name: RulesDocument
RulesDocument.description: Rules document, version 1 (spec 6.3), the file of Export Rules and Upload Folder.

RulesDocumentRule.name: RulesDocumentRule
RulesDocumentRule.description: A rule of a rules document (spec 6.3), the rule item of a profile document without `folder`, since every rule goes into the folder of the path.

RulesUpload.name: RulesUpload
RulesUpload.description: The rules document as base64, at most 4 MiB before encoding, and how it is merged into the folder (`new_only` by default).

Target.name: Target
Target.description:
Where a Redirect goes. A request names a location by `location_id`; `location` is in responses only, read by
id, so a row whose location left the set can still be shown.
